chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Mouse Randolph replaces Swazey; why he left for Terry
summary: Randolph joins after Swazey leaves, later quits because work was spotty, and Swazey wanted to go east.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That's what Mouse told me. Mouse said he thought the band was fantastic. Mouse came in the band--Swazey must have gone out of the band again, so Mouse came in the band after that summer and Mouse was playing trumpet with Floyd Campbell's band in St. Louis. He was working in the band that was playing opposite you; he was a young kind then in St. Louis. He had to take Swazey's place; Swazey had to go out of the band again, he must have gone out of the band.
Oh, Mouse Randolph did take Swazey's place.
He said the band wasn't working that much; he said you were working some and then laying off some. He said that's why he quit the band to go J. Frank Terri (phonetic spelling).

He said because Terri said there wasn't any question about who had the better band, Fred had the best band, but Terri had a steady job somewhere in Ohio--Indiana or Ohio. He said the band wasn't working that much. That's why he left.
Swazey was only in the band twice; I don't think he was in the band three times.
No, he was in the band twice.
I wonder why he would have left?
Swazey wanted to go back, wanted to go east.
